description: India: capital gains rules for a resident individual. Coverage: transfers on or after 2025-04-01 (FY 2025-26 onward). Earlier years had mid-year rate changes and are refused.

ita2025_s196.title: Income-tax Act, 2025, section 196 (tax on short-term capital gains in certain cases; was section 111A)

ita2025_secondary.title: Secondary summaries of the Income-tax Act, 2025 capital gains provisions (sections 197, 198; holding periods)

us_stocks_secondary.title: Broker guides on taxation of US stocks for Indian residents

advance_tax.note: Instalment schedule and the relief for capital gains arising after a due date, from secondary summaries of section 234C. Statute text not fetched.

fno_audit.note: Rs 1 crore generally; Rs 10 crore where cash receipts and payments are each within 5%. Whether option premium is added to F&O turnover under the current ICAI guidance note is disputed between sources, so both figures are computed.

listed_equity.label: Listed equity shares, equity-oriented mutual fund units and business trust units, STT paid

foreign_equity.label: Shares listed only outside India (for example US stocks) and other unlisted shares
foreign_equity.note: Gains must be computed in INR. Rule 115 conversion (SBI TT buying rate on the last day of the month before the transfer) is not automated: supply INR amounts.

debt_fund_post_2023.label: Specified (debt-oriented) mutual fund units acquired on or after 1 Apr 2023
debt_fund_post_2023.note: Always treated as short-term and taxed at slab rates, whatever the holding period (section 50AA of the 1961 Act).

listed_other.label: Other listed securities, for example gold and silver ETFs

unlisted_other.label: Other unlisted capital assets, for example gold funds-of-funds and overseas funds-of-funds

not_handled: Surcharge (income above Rs 50 lakh) and its 15% cap on equity gains
Set-off of losses between buckets and carry-forward from earlier years (reported, not applied)
Shortfall of the basic exemption limit adjusted against special-rate gains
Derivatives (F&O) and intraday equity: these are business income, not capital gains
Buybacks, bonus stripping, corporate actions that change cost (splits, bonuses, demergers)
Non-residents, HUFs, companies, and the US-person tax view
